defects.description: Glossary term 'Role Status' (Статус роли) is incorrectly translated as 'статусы Роль'.
The term 'value' is incorrectly translated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The term 'defaults' (referring to values) is incorrectly translated as 'замечания' (remarks).
Literal word-for-word translation resulting in grammatically incorrect Russian.
Glossary term 'Эскалация' is used in the nominative case where the accusative is required.
Glossary terms 'Фаза' and 'Консенсус' are used in the nominative case where the dative/prepositional is required.
Glossary term 'Роль' is used in the nominative case where the genitive is required.
